notes:
C601 / R601 / R602 feed an attenuated SEND only. Dry does not pass through an op-amp.
600 ohm tank input is seller confirmed; coil R/L and allowable current remain unmeasured.
Set RV601 to minimum before commissioning. 220R is series isolation, not a guaranteed current limiter.

2250 ohm tank output; high impedance recovery input. RV602 controls wet only.
K3 shorts the wet branch via R610. U12A now processes WET ONLY.
Expression-pedal gain-control stage remains a separate open interface; this draft does not implement it.

R612 carries passive dry from FX_RETURN to MIX_OUT. R618 adds wet through 1M.
Dry gain is independent of RV602 and K3, but passive loading causes fixed attenuation.
No dry audio passes through U10/U11/U12. Original C19/R24 and phase inverter remain.
PCB layout must change; the old 160 x 100 board is not this circuit. Cabinet is already delivered.

Received Mable tank: 3 springs, 600 ohm input, 2250 ohm output, medium decay, no lock.
Install horizontal, OPEN SIDE DOWN. Input insulated; output grounded to tank case.
Keep tank return shielded; avoid a second audio/chassis ground bond. Preserve protective earth.
Actual tank dimensions and cabinet assembly clearance still require measurement.
